routines.name: Delivery blockers
routines.prompt: List approved changes past the configured inactivity window. Check worker status and cite missing decisions, quota, or evidence. Offer resume in place.

routines.name: Review queue
routines.prompt: Find review-ready PRs with a new head SHA since the last completed review. Deduplicate against worker handoffs. Report candidates requiring review.

routines.name: Merged documentation drift
routines.prompt: Inspect merged PRs since the last successful scan. Report residual documentation gaps with source PR, page and proposed edit. Recheck if another PR fixed the gap.

routines.name: Maintenance digest
routines.prompt: Report eligible merged worktrees, retained local state, finished work without PR, recurring CI failures and outstanding routine upgrades. Propose one batch; perform no removal from this job.

routines.name: Security advisory catch-up
routines.prompt: Reconcile configured advisory and scanner sources against inventory and open PRs. Report new affected or unknown cases. Track deployed fixes by artifact evidence.

routines.name: Release readiness
routines.prompt: Check active release candidates and promotions. Report only changed readiness or a decision due. Identify the exact revision and artifact.

routines.name: Infrastructure health digest
routines.prompt: Reconcile authorized monitoring, deploy state, certs, capacity and last successful backups. Report changes and blind spots. Let the monitoring service own urgent paging.

routines.name: Recovery readiness
routines.prompt: Check restore evidence, RPO/RTO and runbook freshness. Propose a drill on an approved isolated target. Do not run a restore.

routines.name: Explicit review requested
routines.prompt: Verify the event against trigger options. Match the PR and current head, then follow the approved review workflow.

routines.name: Worktree closure candidate
routines.prompt: Check the configured integration branch and match the merge to a known worktree. Add a candidate to the digest. Perform no removal from this event.

routines.name: CI failure triage
routines.prompt: Read the matching run if accessible. Deduplicate by repo, SHA, check and failure signature. Report probable cause, affected scope and evidence.

routines.name: Security alert triage
routines.prompt: Verify advisory identity and affected inventory. Use a private chat and align with the scheduled catch-up dedupe key. Report applicability and recommend next steps.

routines.name: Deployment verification
routines.prompt: Resolve the environment and deployed revision or digest. Verify the expected candidate and smoke-test evidence. Report mismatches.

routines.name: Monitoring event
routines.prompt: Only accept allowlisted sources and environments. Deduplicate by incident ID. Read linked telemetry and report observed status with no production writes.
